headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Result Update | Sector: Real Estate Ancillary SBICAP Securities Limited | 2 Key highlights of 2QFY27 result Healthy 2QFY27 volume-led growth despite temporary margin headwinds: Carysil delivered a decent 2QFY27 performance with revenue growth of 14.6% YoY at Rs 276 cr driven by robust demand across quartz and stainless-steel sinks.
EBITDA/PAT grew 12.3%/5.8% YoY to Rs 52 cr/Rs 29 cr respectively.
EBITDA margin declined 38 bps YoY to 18.8% due to elevated employee and freight costs.

Quartz sink/stainless-steel sink/faucet volumes grew 9.9%/7.8%/8.0% YoY to 2,17,000/47,000/10,000 units respectively while kitchen appliances & others volumes remained broadly flat YoY at 11,000 units.
valuation: Maintain Buy – Target Price unchanged at Rs 1,391: Carysil’s healthy 2QFY27 sales momentum reflects sustained business momentum supported by robust demand, expanding customer reach and execution of strategic growth initiatives.
We value the stock at 30x of its rolling 1-yr forward EPS and keep our target price unchanged at Rs 1,391 which provides an upside potential of 45.9% for the next 12-18 months.
